3160.title: Inline workflow rows omit child-thread navigation
3160.rootCauseOneLine: The inline workflow card omits the activation callback required for actionable agent rows to render as buttons and navigate to their child threads.
3160.proposedFix: Reuse one guarded child-thread activation callback for the inline workflow card and side panel, with a regression covering actionable and inert rows.
3160.caveats: The behavior was reproduced through the repository's component harness rather than a live workflow because the automation was prohibited from starting a workflow.
